question: Estimate the adoption of voice assistants in Indian vernacular language markets (Hindi, Tamil, Telugu).
idealClarificationQuestions: Voice assistant = Google Assistant, Alexa, Siri, Bixby? All of them.
Vernacular = users who interact in non-English (primarily Hindi or regional language)? Yes.
Metric: any voice query in past month? Yes (MAU).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total smartphone vernacular users → voice-feature awareness → frequency.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Indian smartphone users primarily comfortable in vernacular: ~500M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Used voice (any query) in past month: ~30% of aware = ~90M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total monthly voice assistant users in vernacular: ~90M.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Indian smartphone users primarily comfortable in vernacular
Of these, aware that voice assistant exists on their phone
Used voice (any query) in past month
Of which, regular users (multiple uses per week)
Total monthly voice assistant users in vernacular

calculationFlow: Of these, aware that voice assistant exists on their phone: ~60% = 300M.
Used voice (any query) in past month: ~30% of aware = ~90M.
Of which, regular users (multiple uses per week): ~30% = 27M.
